raw_resume.summary: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering graduate (2025) seeking a Software Development Engineer II role. Full-stack developer with hands-on experience building scalable REST APIs and web applications using Java, Spring Boot, React and TypeScript. Demonstrated ability to design and implement systems end-to-end, from database schema to containerised deployment.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses and process payments. Integrated Razorpay webhooks for payment state transitions, wrote 40 JUnit tests, and containerised the application with Docker.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Designed and implemented a Java and Spring Boot service with MySQL schema for study room bookings. Piloted with 120 students over 2 weeks and eliminated double-booking conflicts.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to display real-time order status, deployed locally with Docker Compose.

profile_improvement_tips: Study and implement algorithms (sorting, searching, graph traversal, dynamic programming) in a project or coding challenge to demonstrate algorithmic thinking.
Design a distributed system project (e.g. a multi-service microservices architecture with message queues, caching, or eventual consistency) to show understanding of distributed systems principles.
Learn and apply design patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy) explicitly in your code and document them in project READMEs or code comments.
Contribute to open-source projects or create a peer code review process in your projects to gain hands-on code review experience and document it.
raw_resume.growth_note: You are a fresher (graduating 2025) applying for a role requiring 3+ years of professional software development and 2+ years of system design experience. Your projects demonstrate full-stack capability and testing discipline, but the JD's core focus on distributed systems, algorithms, design patterns and code review is not yet evident in your profile. Gain 2-3 years of professional experience and deepen your systems and algorithms knowledge before this role becomes a strong fit.
